comparison.objective: Seal a preloaded carton by closing four flaps, applying and cutting one connected strip from an ordinary tape roll, and leaving the adhesive seal retained; candidate instead separates loose ceramic media from washers through a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Tape payout, thin-ribbon handling, pressure-dependent adhesion, flap folding, cutting, and tool parking versus bimanual screen lifting, load sharing, controlled agitation, selective aperture passage, and support reseating.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires flap closure within 5°, specified seam/end-wrap bond coverage, a detached strip, parked tools, and a 2 s released hold; candidate requires ≥98% media recovery, total washer retention, supported screen, 60 mm hand clearance, and a 3 s dwell, with spill/passage/damage failures. No material rubric detail is missing for comparison.
comparison.reason: The tested abilities differ materially: creating and retaining an adhesive carton seal does not test selective many-body separation through physical apertures.
